# Pre-repair assertion runtime

Generated by the native runtime at source
`44302912257d49dbf033fe2543400c640f6fa71b`, the source behind GaugeDesk's
published v1.0.1 runtime contract. This is a synthetic workflow, not user data.

Place `generate.rs.txt` at
`crates/whipplescript-kernel/examples/mtarget_legacy_assertions.rs` in that
revision, then run:

```sh
cargo run --locked -p whipplescript-kernel --example mtarget_legacy_assertions -- target/legacy-assertions
```

The output directory must not exist. Each SQL file is the complete
`sqlite3 DATABASE .dump` after the generator closes its three real stores.
The source and provenance JSON are the original generator output. Keep the
old event payloads and schemas; never regenerate this fixture with the new
runtime to make an upgrade test pass.

One item has completed all three record positions (top-level, after, nested
after), including two completed coercion effects. Its log predates
`instance.created`. The upgrade test must preserve that history and version
binding, execute no old effects, and give a genuinely new item's equal-valued
assertions their own evidence.
